name: r0-rope-ldg256-os-stel
author: solx-loop
description: RoPE is a pure stream with a per-row L2-resident cos/sin table; a fused one-shot kernel where each thread owns both halves of its column pair (no shuffles, one pass), with 256-bit accesses and evict_last stores, runs at the copy ceiling, and the CTA size must follow the row count because CTA dispatch (0.55 us per 1000 CTAs) caps 64-thread grids on the L band.
